{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Display basic info about the data
sales_df.info()

# Display the first few rows
display(sales_df.head())

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()
print("Missing values:", missing_values)

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = sales_df.duplicated().sum()
print("Duplicate rows:", duplicates)

# List unique values in the 'order_status' column
unique_statuses = sales_df['order_status'].unique()
print("Unique order statuses:", unique_statuses)

# List unique values in the 'order_type' column
unique_types = sales_df['order_type'].unique()
print("Unique order types:", unique_types)"}
